question.text: There are two long co-axial solenoids of same length $l$. The inner and outer coils have radii $r_1$ and $r_2$ and number of turns per unit length $n_1$ and $n_2$, respectively. The ratio of mutual inductance to the self-inductance of the inner-coil is:

solution.text:
The rate of mutual inductance is given by
$\mathrm{M}=\mu_0 \mathrm{n}_1 \mathrm{n}_2 \pi \mathrm{~m}_1^2$     ....(i)
The rate of self inductance is given by
$\mathrm{L}=\mu_0 \mathrm{n}_1^2 \pi \mathrm{r}_1^2$    .....(ii)
Dividing (i) by (ii)
$\Rightarrow \frac{\mathrm{M}}{\mathrm{L}}=\frac{\mathrm{n}_2}{\mathrm{n}_1}$
